title: There or it - Choosing the right subject

options.answer: It is a lot of students in the classroom.
There are a lot of students in the classroom.
There is a lot of students in the classroom.

explanation.en: Use 'there are' with plural nouns. 'Students' is a plural noun, so 'there are' is the correct choice.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'there are' с существительными во множественном числе. 'Students' - существительное во множественном числе, поэтому 'there are' - правильный выбор.
explanation.uz: 'There are' so'zini ko'plikdagi otlar bilan ishlating. 'Students' ko'plikdagi ot bo'lgani uchun, 'there are' to'g'ri tanlov hisoblanadi.

options.answer: It cold outside today.
It is cold outside today.
There is cold outside today.

explanation.en: Use 'It is' to talk about the weather. 'It' is used as a dummy subject for time, weather, and distance.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'It is', когда говорите о погоде. 'It' используется как безличное подлежащее для времени, погоды и расстояния.
explanation.uz: Ob-havo haqida gapirish uchun 'It is' so'zidan foydalaning. 'It' so'zi vaqt, ob-havo va masofa uchun mavhum ega sifatida ishlatiladi.

options.answer: There is easy to learn English.
It is easy to learn English.
There are easy to learn English.

explanation.en: Use 'It is' when you describe a situation or an activity. 'It' acts as the subject for the infinitive phrase 'to learn English'.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'It is', когда описываете ситуацию или действие. 'It' выступает в качестве подлежащего для инфинитивной фразы 'to learn English'.
explanation.uz: Biror vaziyat yoki harakatni tasvirlaganingizda 'It is' so'zidan foydalaning. 'It' 'to learn English' infinitiv iborasi uchun ega vazifasini bajaradi.

options.answer: It is two books on the table.
There are two books on the table.
There is two books on the table.

explanation.en: Use 'there is' or 'there are' to state the existence of something. Since 'two books' is plural, 'there are' is correct.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'there is' или 'there are', чтобы констатировать существование чего-либо. Поскольку 'two books' (две книги) - это множественное число, 'there are' - правильный вариант.
explanation.uz: Biror narsaning mavjudligini aytish uchun 'there is' yoki 'there are' so'zlaridan foydalaning. 'Two books' (ikki kitob) ko'plikda bo'lgani uchun, 'there are' to'g'ri bo'ladi.

options.answer: There is 10 o'clock in the morning.
It is 10 o'clock in the morning.
It are 10 o'clock in the morning.

explanation.en: Use 'It is' when you are telling the time. 'It' is the dummy subject for time.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'It is', когда называете время. 'It' - это безличное подлежащее для времени.
explanation.uz: Vaqtni aytayotganingizda 'It is' so'zidan foydalaning. 'It' so'zi vaqt uchun mavhum ega hisoblanadi.

options.answer: There is a long way to the city.
It is a long way to the city.

explanation.en: Use 'It is' to talk about distance. 'It' is the dummy subject for distance.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'It is', чтобы говорить о расстоянии. 'It' - это безличное подлежащее для расстояния.
explanation.uz: Masofa haqida gapirish uchun 'It is' so'zidan foydalaning. 'It' masofa uchun mavhum ega hisoblanadi.

options.answer: There are a big problem with my computer.
There is a big problem with my computer.
It is a big problem with my computer.

explanation.en: Use 'there is' or 'there are' to state the existence of something. 'A big problem' is a singular noun, so 'there is' is correct.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'there is' или 'there are', чтобы констатировать существование чего-либо. 'A big problem' (большая проблема) - существительное в единственном числе, поэтому 'there is' - правильный вариант.
explanation.uz: Biror narsaning mavjudligini aytish uchun 'there is' yoki 'there are' so'zlaridan foydalaning. 'A big problem' birlikdagi ot bo'lgani uchun, 'there is' to'g'ri hisoblanadi.

options.answer: There is my favorite book on the shelf.

explanation.en: Use 'It is' when you are identifying a specific item. 'It' refers to 'my favorite book'.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'It is', когда вы указываете на конкретный предмет. 'It' относится к 'my favorite book'.
explanation.uz: Muayyan buyumni aniqlash uchun 'It is' so'zidan foydalaning. 'It' 'my favorite book' so'ziga ishora qiladi.

options.answer: There is a lot of noise in the street.
There are a lot of noise in the street.
It is a lot of noise in the street.

explanation.en: Use 'there is' to state the existence of an uncountable noun. 'Noise' is an uncountable noun.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'there is', чтобы констатировать существование неисчисляемого существительного. 'Noise' - это неисчисляемое существительное.
explanation.uz: Sanalmaydigan otning mavjudligini aytish uchun 'there is' so'zidan foydalaning. 'Noise' sanalmaydigan ot hisoblanadi.

options.answer: There is a good idea to go to the park.

It are a good idea to go to the park.

explanation.en: Use 'It is' when you give an opinion about a situation or activity. 'It' is the subject for the infinitive phrase 'to go to the park'.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'It is', когда высказываете мнение о ситуации или действии. 'It' - подлежащее для инфинитивной фразы 'to go to the park'.
explanation.uz: Biror vaziyat yoki harakat haqida fikr bildirganingizda 'It is' so'zidan foydalaning. 'It' 'to go to the park' infinitiv iborasi uchun ega hisoblanadi.

prompt.en: Fill in the blanks with the correct words

items.text: Hello, my name is Alex. Today I want to tell you about my city. ___1___ is a small but beautiful city. ___2___ are many interesting places to visit, like the museum and the park. ___3___ is a big lake near my house, and ___4___ is very peaceful to sit by the water. When you walk in the city, ___5___ are often a lot of people in the streets. ___6___ is a famous restaurant on Main Street, and ___7___ is always very busy. ___8___ is nice and warm today, so a lot of people are outside. ___9___ is a good time to go for a walk. ___10___ are many tall buildings downtown, and ___11___ is a new one near the station. ___12___ is important to keep the city clean. ___13___ are two new recycling bins on my street. ___14___ is getting late, so I need to go home. ___15___ is my city, and I love it!

explanation.en: 'It' is used for weather, time, and general statements. 'There' is used to show existence of people or things. The last 'This' is used to refer to the city as a whole, a common conversational form.
explanation.ru: 'It' используется для погоды, времени и общих утверждений. 'There' используется для обозначения существования людей или вещей. Последнее 'This' используется для обозначения города в целом, это распространенная разговорная форма.
explanation.uz: 'It' so'zi ob-havo, vaqt va umumiy bayonotlar uchun ishlatiladi. 'There' so'zi odamlar yoki narsalarning mavjudligini ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi. Oxirgi 'This' so'zi shahar haqida umuman gapirganda ishlatiladi, bu keng tarqalgan nutqiy shakl.

prompt.en: Fill in the blanks with the correct words

items.text: My family and I are planning a trip to the mountains. ___1___ is a beautiful place for a holiday. ___2___ are many hiking trails and waterfalls. ___3___ is not cold in the mountains in the summer, and ___4___ is a perfect time to go. ___5___ is fun to explore the nature and take pictures. ___6___ is a small cabin we can rent. ___7___ is very quiet there, and ___8___ is a good place to relax. ___9___ are a lot of animals in the forest, and ___10___ is important to be careful. ___11___ is a long drive to the mountains, but ___12___ is worth it. ___13___ are some friends coming with us, too. ___14___ will be a great trip. ___15___ is a special day for us all to be together.

explanation.en: 'It' is used for descriptions of places, weather, and general statements about activities. 'There' is used to talk about the existence of specific things.
explanation.ru: 'It' используется для описания мест, погоды и общих утверждений о действиях. 'There' используется для разговора о существовании конкретных вещей.
explanation.uz: 'It' so'zi joylar, ob-havo va harakatlar haqidagi umumiy bayonotlar uchun ishlatiladi. 'There' so'zi ma'lum narsalarning mavjudligi haqida gapirish uchun ishlatiladi.

prompt.en: Fill in the blanks with the correct words

items.text: My new school is very big. ___1___ is a huge library on the first floor. ___2___ are many books there, and ___3___ is a quiet place to study. ___4___ is a cafeteria where we can eat lunch. ___5___ is a lot of food there, and ___6___ is always delicious. ___7___ is a new swimming pool, and ___8___ is fun to swim after class. ___9___ are 20 computers in the computer lab. ___10___ is easy to do homework there. ___11___ is a small garden behind the school. ___12___ are some flowers in the garden. ___13___ is a great school, and I like ___14___ a lot. ___15___ is nice to have so many new friends.

explanation.en: Use 'There' to introduce the existence of nouns (library, computers, etc.). Use 'It' to describe a place or situation, to give an opinion, or as a dummy subject.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'There', чтобы представить существование существительных (библиотека, компьютеры и т. д.). Используйте 'It', чтобы описать место или ситуацию, выразить мнение или как безличное подлежащее.
explanation.uz: 'There' so'zini otlarning mavjudligini (kutubxona, kompyuterlar va boshqalar) bildirish uchun ishlating. 'It' so'zini joy yoki vaziyatni tasvirlash, fikr bildirish yoki mavhum ega sifatida ishlating.
